info.value: Sevf ' ityapyeke . ' secane ' iti kecit . ' sevf ' iti pare . dantyAditvaM BAzyaviroDAt upekzyam . BAzye ' ajAdantyaparAH sAdayaH zopadeSAH ... ' iti dfSyate .

examples: 'etAnAsevate yastu tapastasya prahIyate' (BA0 SAM0 192.18). Asevate'sakft sevate juzate, Bajate.
'yatrAprAyaScittaM karmAsevate prAyaScittavati' (Apa0 Da0 1.18.11). Asevate tAtparyeRa karotIti yAvat.
'nizevate SrAntamanA viviktam' (SA0 5.5). nizevate sevate Bajate. nirviSatItyarTaH.
'vipatpratIkArapareRa maNgalaM nizevyate BUtisamutsukena vA' (ku0 5.76). nizevyate pracaryate, Acaryate.
'vEKAnasaM kimanayA vratamA pradAnAd vyApAraroDi madanasya nizevitavyam' (SA0 1.27). nizevitavyaM jozaRIyam, AcaraRIyam.
'evamatandritastrIMScaturo vA mAsAn kriyApaTamupaseveta' (suSruta0 ci0 5.28). upaseveta SIlayet.
'tataH sTitezu tezvatra nAnABogopasevizu' (kaTA0 44.116). nAnA pfTagviDAn BogAnBuYjAnezvityarTaH.

'candanena mahArheRa yasyANgamupasevitam. malena tasyANgamida kaTamAryasya sevyate' (rA0 2.99.35).. upasevitaM suraBIkftam. vAsa upasevAyAmiti curAdizu paWyate. tatra upasevA suganDIkaraRamAheti muktasaMSayam.
